order: Seeded shuffle each round; balanced alternating provider order within pairs.
comparison: Exactly the same state, question instructions and choice criteria; Qwen returns only a JSON map from question id to choice id. No probability/reason/explanation demand on Qwen.
primaryQuality: Exact decision labels against frozen gold. Full bundle correctness and individual labels separately.
primaryLatency: Complete HTTP-response wall time, including JSON read/parse, from the same local runner. Not raw GPU inference or time-to-first-token.
tailMetric: Empirical p95; only 36 trials per task so this is a coarse tail estimate.
plannedAnalysis: Report all trials plus correctness-qualified latency. Paired ratios/bootstraps cluster by unique case rather than treating three repeats as independent cases.
limitations: Synthetic selected cases adapted from earlier work, not a fresh blind hold-out of all prior development.
Gold decisions are authored, not native-human adjudicated.
One region/network/time window and one fast comparison model.
Repeated prompts can benefit provider-side caches; round-level results will be shown.
